name: Commencement of Festivities
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to players this turn.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to players this turn.

needs.what: a combat_only flag on the prevent_damage op (the player DamageShield), so a resolving instant installs a this_turn shield over every player (player: each/any) that prevents only combat damage and lets noncombat damage to players through
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage the op takes only player and duration and its DamageShield prevents ALL damage to the player, so burn and drain would also be stopped -- a strictly better card; the prevent_damage static has combat_only but lives on a printed permanent, matches only permanents via affects (no way to name a seat), and has no 'this turn' duration, so a spell cannot install it
